definitions.short: properly, highly , i.e. surely ; but used adversatively, however
definitions.full: H1297. beram בְּרַם adverb with adversative force, only, nevertheless (derivation uncertain: Nö M 202 = מָא + בָּר , literally except what: בְּרַם ᵑ7 often for אוּלָם אַח, ; Syriac Exod 9:16 ; 21:21 , and in NT for πλήν ; Christian-Palestinian Aramaic , ); — Dan 2:28 ; 4:12 hew down the tree etc., שְׁבֻקוּ ֗֗֗ בְּרַם only leave the stump, etc., 4:20 ; 5:17 ; Ezra 5:13 .
definitions.rootNote: (Aramaic) perhaps from 7313 with a prepositional prefix;
